name: Mahjong 3D Time
author: Addicting Games
description: Mahjong 3D Time is a puzzle game with a 3D twist!. While your average mahjong game is on a flat surface with traditional Chinese symbols, this game is a little bit different. This online game has  3-dimensional features to give you more of a challenge. Instead of Chinese symbols, this game uses cute icons with bold colors. You can find cubes with trees, hearts, flowers, and even stars. There are 50 levels of this game for you to tackle and solve! While this is a casual game, each level is timed and has its own pattern for you to conquer. Submit your score to see if you are one of the top players for this online game!
